case.summary: The case for card C08623-K2 concerns a $49.00 in-person transaction on 2016-12-10. Customer ID undisclosed reported they did not make the purchase, 3 of the card-detail match flags M1-M9 came back F, and 13 transactions occurred on the card in the 48 hours ending at the flagged one. The bank has 5 confirmed-fraud case(s) already closed on this card (CC-4957, CC-3682, CC-3327, CC-2935). External email-domain intelligence classifies 'me.com' as an address tied to a paid internet, cable or phone subscription, which means a billing relationship and a credit check stand behind it. The card was placed in the graph's giant device-sharing component (2,500 cards), and known fraud pattern 5 assessed the activity as mixed-channel consistent with stolen credentials at probability 0.85. The verdict is fraud with exposure of $49.00 and case ID undisclosed.
